page.overview:
Who is Nine Stars?

The are a group of gods responsible for governing over different planets in the solar system.

When Sun Wukong caused chaos in Heaven and fled, the Nine Stars were the first gods sent to arrest him. They busted down the doors to Water Curtain Cave and held the metal bridge, attacking with a war dance, but were easily subdued by Sun Wukong.
